title: Better Sleep With Simple Night Ritual

scenes.text: The 3‑minute habit that transforms sleep tonight
Dim the lights about 30 minutes before bed to boost melatonin production
scenes.label: DIM LIGHTS BEFORE BED

scenes.text: Enable a blue‑light filter on screens or avoid devices entirely after sunset
scenes.label: LIMIT BLUE LIGHT

scenes.text: Keep your bedroom around 65°F (18‑19°C) for optimal sleep cycles
scenes.label: COOL BEDROOM TEMPERATURE

scenes.text: Follow if your body is worth 60 seconds a day.

description: Three tiny tweaks you can add tonight to improve sleep quality without medication. Try them tomorrow and feel the difference. Stay tuned for more simple science‑backed habits.
